title: Geomax Zenith60 GNSS Smart Antenna
summary:
The Zenith60 is a multi-frequency GNSS smart antenna built for construction work, with calibration-free tilt compensation that stays accurate around steel and machinery because it uses no magnetometer.

555 channels on the NovAtel OEM719 engine, RTK at 8 mm + 1 ppm on a single baseline, 4G LTE as standard, and an optional UHF radio for base-to-rover coverage across a site. Positioning runs at 5 Hz, or 20 Hz as an option.

Hot-swappable batteries give 12.5 hours static and 11 hours rover. Variants cover LTE, LTE-UHF, and IMU packages, and it pairs with GeoMax and Leica controllers running field software for stakeout and data collection.
specs: 555 channels, multi-frequency multi-constellation (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, NavIC, SBAS)
RTK single baseline: H 8 mm + 1 ppm / V 15 mm + 1 ppm; network RTK H 8 mm + 0.5 ppm / V 15 mm + 0.5 ppm
Static H 3 mm + 0.5 ppm / V 5 mm + 0.5 ppm; static long H 3 mm + 0.1 ppm / V 3.5 mm + 0.4 ppm
Calibration-free tilt compensation, additional H uncertainty 2 cm up to 30 degrees tilt, magnetically resistant
Positioning rate 5 Hz, 20 Hz optional; RTK initialisation typically 4 s
4G LTE (QUECTEL EG25-G), optional SATEL TR4+ UHF 403-473 MHz, Bluetooth, WLAN, USB and serial
IP68; operating -40 to +65 degrees C; 1.14 kg without batteries, 1.36 kg with two
Hot-swappable Li-ion 3.4 Ah: 12.5 h static / 11 h rover
accessories: Survey pole, pole holder and tribrach
